summary.name: Summary
summary.content: Experienced DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer with a strong background in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability. Skilled in designing scalable systems and improving delivery pipelines for high-impact platforms in media, telecom, and finance.

items.summary:
Project for Sky UK, supporting infrastructure for streaming platforms such as PeacockTV, Now, SkyShowtime, and Showmax. Responsible for preparing and scaling environments for major live events (e.g. NFL).

  • Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines across Kubernetes (EKS) environments.

  • Managed Akamai GTM and properties for global traffic routing and content optimization.

  • Built observability dashboards and alerting systems integrated with Slack and incident response tools.

  • Provisioned AWS resources using IaC tools.

  • Applied FinOps principles to scale down environments during low-traffic periods.

  • Remediated vulnerabilities on Linux systems and the internal codebase.

  • Maintained observability stack: Thanos, Prometheus, certificate-exporter.

  • Deployed ElasticSearch clusters on Elastic Cloud.

Technologies used:

  • Languages & Scripting: Bash, Python

  • CI/CD & DevOps Tools: GitHub Actions, Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible

  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Datadog

  • Cloud & Infra: AWS , Akamai

  • Databases: ElasticSearch, Couchbase, RDS, MongoDB Atlas

  • Operating Systems: Linux Ubuntu

  • Version Control: Git

  • Methodologies: FinOps, SRE practices, Agile

  • Collaboration & Incident Response: Slack, On-call rotations

Project for DU Telecom (Dubai). Led migration from legacy infrastructure to OpenShift. Participated in new app deployment initiatives and resolved technical blockers for Vodafone Germany (Kubernetes upgrade).

  • Architected and migrated monolithic apps to OpenShift.

  • Helped design disaster recovery environments.

  • Collaborated with development and support teams to unblock and finalize critical initiatives.

Technologies used:

  • Languages & Scripting: Bash

  • CI/CD & DevOps Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI

  • Monitoring & Observability: AppDynamics, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Cloud & Infra: OpenShift, Kubernetes

  • Operating Systems: Linux (RHEL, CentOS)

  • Version Control: Git (GitLab, GitHub)

  • Methodologies: Agile, DevOps, ITIL

  • Collaboration Tools: Jira, Confluence

Project for J. Safra Sarasin (Switzerland). Migrated infrastructure from Azure Cloud to on-prem OpenShift platform. Built and standardized CI/CD for >50 microservices, mentored teams, and received promotion for impact delivered.

  • Developed pipelines using Azure DevOps for full application lifecycle.

  • Built environments using Terraform, Helm, Kustomize.

  • Managed services: Vault, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, Knative.

  • Fostered DevOps culture and multidisciplinary collaboration with developers.

Technologies used:

  • Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, YAML

  • CI/CD & DevOps Tools: Azure DevOps, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform

  • Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana

  • Cloud & Infra: OpenShift (on-prem), Linux servers

  • Databases: MongoDB

  • Queues & Messaging: Kafka, Zookeeper

  • Security & Secrets: Hashicorp Vault

  • Operating Systems: Linux (RHEL)

  • Version Control: Git (Azure Repos)

  • Methodologies: DevOps, GitOps, Agile

Projects for Itaú Bank, including API Gateway support, developer onboarding automation, and platform-as-a-service creation on OpenStack.

  • Maintained and provisioned API gateways (Axway and AWS Gateway)

  • Automated developer onboarding (GitLab repos, dashboards, monitoring, pipelines, infrastructure)

  • Built Jenkins pipelines for digital banking services.

  • Automated resource provisioning via Terraform on OpenStack.

Technologies used:

  • Languages & Scripting: Bash

  • CI/CD & DevOps Tools: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Puppet, Ansible, Terraform

  • Monitoring & Observability: AppDynamics, Grafana

  • Cloud & Infra: AWS, OpenStack, Axway API Gateway

  • Operating Systems: Linux

  • Version Control: Git (GitLab)

  • Methodologies: Agile, DevOps

  • Other Tools: Jira, Confluence, Jumpboxes

items.company: Support Group of São Paulo ‑ Brazilian Air Force
items.position: I.T Analyst & System Administrator (Compulsory Military Service)
items.summary:
Served as an enlisted I.T professional during compulsory military service, managing mission-critical systems, infrastructure, and internal support for a secure and highly available network environment. Played a key role in systems automation, security policy enforcement, and infrastructure stability.

  • Provisioned and managed Linux servers on XenServer virtualization platform.

  • Used Ansible for configuration management across over 100 Ubuntu desktops.

  • Implemented centralized log aggregation with Graylog and monitoring with Zabbix.

  • Designed and enforced network security policies using PfSense, Squid, SquidGuard, and McAfee antivirus.

  • Managed and automated backup routines with Bacula.

  • Administered OpenLDAP and Samba4 for centralized user authentication and directory services.

Technologies used:

  • Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu Server/Desktop), FreeBSD (PfSense)

  • Virtualization: XenServer

  • Automation & Configuration: Ansible

  • Monitoring & Logging: Zabbix, Graylog

  • Security: PfSense, Squid, SquidGuard, McAfee

  • Backup: Bacula

  • Directory Services: OpenLDAP, Samba4

  • Methodologies: ITIL, preventive and corrective maintenance, Level 2/3 support
